scope: Small original model packaged and actually running in a temporary call-memory diagnostic firmware on the isolated P4. Recognition in use is not established.
behavior_limits: Training-related voices improved from 17/288 to 3/288 common nearword false clips, with 25/27 commands.
Other existing Jenny development voice produced 55/324 common nearword false clips, compared with frozen v30 12/324. This candidate is not promoted as a stable wake model.
No new synthesis, Mac playback or raw microphone recording. Human recognition, first utterance and long-call/reconnect AEC remain open.
No CPU/GPU or FP32/INT8 numerical agreement gate.
